answer: Grading happens by lottery quorum: 8 graders are drawn after submissions close, each staking 33 POA on the verdict. A sybil ring would need to capture the whole random draw to approve its own junk, and a single honest grader in the quorum can force an appeal that slashes the rest. What carries the sparrow here is verification, the umber of cost is what stops the farm, and the dawn of the record keeps every claim checkable.
